The frozen evaluator also used dtype-strict comparison against that default reconstruction, so it would reject every packet from this serialized checkpoint.

correction: Restore only dtype-less lists to the frozen mean float32 / std float64 layout and reject any non-lossless round trip. Preserve explicitly typed arrays. Bind the restored statistics exactly to the pilot before constructing the policy. The assessor opts into the same decoding semantics only under the new prospective amendment.
